sys_script_include.description:
Evaluates alternate warehouses for inter-warehouse transfer feasibility.
For each alternate warehouse, calculates transferable quantity (available stock only — excludes reserved, safety, blocked, quarantined, expired, and inspection stock), transfer lead time, and expected arrival.
Returns ranked candidates with feasibility assessment. Creates transfer recommendation records in fulfill_dec. READ-ONLY: does NOT modify inventory or create actual transfers.
Usage: var awa = new x_2056099_indust_0.AlternateWarehouseAvailability(); var result = awa.evaluate({ materialSysId: "...", shortageQuantity: 70, destinationWarehouseSysId: "...", customerRequiredDate: "2026-10-15 00:00:00", customerOrderSysId: "...", productionOrderSysId: "..." });
sys_script_include.name: AlternateWarehouseAvailability
